subject: The country of origin of an electrical actuator

baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup

rule_check.label: Does not shift under 102.20 (DC motor fails) unless de minimis

shown.description: Move the motor stator, the gearbox assembly and the screw drive and the housing and machined block to Canada

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, all major components of the electrical actuator (DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, housings, sensor PCBA, and electrical apparatus) are made in China and undergo simple assembly in Canada, leaving origin in China. In Variant B, the core mechanical and electro-mechanical subassemblies—the DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, and housings—are manufactured in-house in Canada, with only the sensor PCBA and electrical apparatus sourced from China. As in N346297 (where an electric winch's origin was Thailand because the electric motor and drum assemblies were produced there and assembled there), producing the motor, gearbox, screw drive, and housings in Canada confers Canadian origin.

verdict.reasoning: In Variant A, all major subassemblies (DC motor, gearbox, screw drive, PCBA, electrical apparatus, and housings) are made in China and merely assembled in Canada, conferring Chinese origin. In Variant B, the production of the DC motor, gearbox assembly, screw drive, sensor PCBA, and electrical apparatus moves to Canada, leaving only the housings sourced from China. Following N346297 (where an electromechanical winch's origin was determined by the country producing the core electric motor and drive subassemblies even when final assembly was not complex), manufacturing all core functional subassemblies in Canada confers Canadian origin.

others.description: Move the motor stator to Canada

verdict.reasoning: Electrical actuators consisting of an electric motor combined with a gearbox and screw drive are classified as electric motors under heading 8501 (see N342620), where the electric motor imparts the essential character. As seen in N346297 (electric winch with a Chinese gearbox assembled with a domestically produced electric motor), when the final assembly is not complex, origin follows the core electric motor subassembly rather than the imported gearbox. Because the 12 VDC brushed motor in Variant B is manufactured in-house in Canada and assembled there with the Chinese gearbox, screw drive, and PCBA, the country of origin shifts to Canada.

draft.plan: Move the motor stator, the gearbox assembly and the screw drive and the housing and machined block to Canada
draft.question:
What is the country of origin of DC motor actuator, produced as described above, under the Part 102 rules of origin (the general rules of 19 C.F.R. § 102.11, applied in order, with the tariff shifts of § 102.20), for purposes of country of origin marking (19 C.F.R. § 102.0)?

This request concerns the origin of the merchandise for marking under the Part 102 rules only. It does not ask CBP to decide the country of origin for Section 301 duties, which is a separate question, and the requester does not contend that marking origin settles it.
draft.tariff_shift: Tariff-shift check (19 C.F.R. § 102.20): applied to the component codes in the bill of materials, with the good finished in Canada, the rule gives Canada (19 C.F.R. § 102.11(a)(3); 19 C.F.R. § 102.20(o), 8501). [CONFIRM WITH COUNSEL]
notes: Asked under the Part 102 rules (19 C.F.R. § 102.11) for marking because the prediction behind the requester's position was made under that regime. Marking origin does not settle the separate Section 301 question; this draft does not ask it. Confirm that regime applies.
